QUANTUM VULNERABLE   Shor's algorithm breaks these outright

  DSA  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm solves the finite-field discrete log.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204)
      ops.go:6   "crypto/dsa"

  ECDSA  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm solves the discrete log on the curve.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204), or SLH-DSA if you need hash-based
      ops.go:7   "crypto/ecdsa"

  Ed25519  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Edwards-curve discrete log falls to Shor's algorithm.
    migrate to: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204)
      ops.go:8   "crypto/ed25519"

  RSA  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Shor's algorithm factors the modulus in polynomial time.
    migrate to: ML-KEM-768 for key establishment, ML-DSA-65 for signatures
      ops.go:10   "crypto/rsa"

  X25519  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Curve25519 discrete log falls to Shor's algorithm.
    migrate to: hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768, then ML-KEM alone
      ops.go:13   "golang.org/x/crypto/curve25519"


REVIEW               reduced margin under Grover, usually acceptable

  AES  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Grover halves effective key length. AES-256 stays at 128-bit margin.
    migrate to: AES-256 if currently AES-128
      ops.go:5   "crypto/aes"

  SHA-256  (no call sites, 1 import)
    Grover gives a quadratic speedup only. Still acceptable.
    migrate to: no action needed
      ops.go:11   "crypto/sha256"
